query:
SELECT om.user_id, om.role, om.status, p.name, p.role as profile_role
FROM organization_members om
LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = om.user_id
WHERE p.name ILIKE '%jordan%' OR p.name ILIKE '%Jordan%'
LIMIT 10;
